titleZh: 黄仁勋辞职对美国开源模型是挫折
titleOriginal: Jensen Huang's resignation is a setback for US open models, as his funding gave open-source developers time to find their footing and will very likely dry up (Nathan Lambert/Interconnects AI)
summary: Nathan Lambert / Interconnects AI表示，黄仁勋的辞职是美国开源模型的挫折，因为他的资助给了开源开发者时间站稳脚跟，资金很可能随之枯竭。
keyPoints: 黄仁勋辞职是美国开源模型的挫折
他的资助帮助开源开发者站稳脚跟
